//: Copy this file to appsettings.Development.json, which is git-ignored, and put the
real password in that copy. The password is the MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD you set in db/.env.
appsettings.Development.json overrides appsettings.json, so nothing else has to change.
TrustServerCertificate=True is required against a local or containerised server: it
presents a certificate it signed itself, and without this the connection fails during
the handshake with an error that talks about the server rather than the certificate.
Every entry under Serilog is optional. MinimumLevel is one of Verbose, Debug,
Information, Warning, Error or Fatal. An empty Directory means
%LOCALAPPDATA%\VideoGameManager\logs; an explicit one may use environment
variables. RetainedFileCountLimit is how many daily files are kept. A value that
cannot be used falls back to the default instead of stopping the application.
